message.content: {"caption":"Workflow separating skill evolution from post-evolution evaluation.","description":"A left-to-right process diagram. The “Available inputs” box contains task T, workspace W, initial skill S₀, and frozen agent π. A right-pointing arrow connects it to “Stub evolution,” which contains paired audits, PACE, and a Task-Compiled Verifier. A right-pointing arrow labeled “terminates” leads from Stub evolution to “Evaluation conditions,” which lists No skill, Curated skill, and Evolved skill. A right-pointing arrow labeled “evaluate” connects that box to “Post-evolution evaluation,” where the benchmark verifier assigns the task reward. “During evolution” appears in blue above Stub evolution, and “After evolution” appears in gray above Post-evolution evaluation. A red × marks the note that the benchmark verifier, test content, and task reward are unavailable during evolution.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
